source.method: Every cell is re-run from its archived config block (same seed, same RNG stream) and gated to bit-equality on coverage/map_bias/rail_fraction/completion_fraction. The P-P curve is the empirical CDF of L_i = int_{p >= p(h_true)} p dh over realizations; truth is inside HPD_q iff L_i <= q.
